svg.aria-label: A Monday to Friday timeline. On Monday morning a tiny teal block: write and test, about an hour. Then a long hatched coral bar labelled waiting runs to Friday, marked with what happens along the way: the reviewer is in meetings until 3pm, a fourth PR lands in the queue, a merge conflict, a question and another round trip, a re-review. A tick on Friday: merged. A note: productive to waiting time is roughly one to twenty.
svg.text: ONE HOUR OF WORK, FOUR DAYS IN A QUEUE
the life of a fix that was ready before lunch on Monday
a one-hour fix that takes four days to merge is a four-day fix
